text: Receive orders directly from third-party marketplaces into this same order system — the same kitchen, the same POS, the same reporting as every other order.

Who actually picks up and delivers a placed order — separate from whether delivery is offered at all and what it costs the customer (both set above). "Your own delivery" needs no setup: your staff dispatch and track every delivery by hand from the order's detail view. Connecting Uber Direct hands dispatch to a real courier automatically instead.
Requires your own Uber Direct merchant account (connect below).

Optional: charge a different fee depending on how far the delivery is, instead of one flat rate for the whole radius. The tightest-fitting bracket applies — e.g. a 3km order matches the first tier that covers it. Leave empty to keep the flat fee above for every distance.
Turning on online payment requires a connected payment account — see Online Payments below. Card/wallet details never touch this platform's servers either way.
Accept online payments from your customers. Payments go directly to your connected account — we don't take a commission on your direct restaurant orders.
The fastest, most secure option. You'll be taken to Stripe to set up your account — we never see or store your credentials.

Custom domains don't serve customers yet. You can add and verify your domain now — once custom-domain hosting is switched on, this page will show the DNS record that sends customers to your storefront. Until then, customers order through your GarnishTable storefront link.
Enable card-terminal payments for this location
